function envoy_on_request(req)
  -- Defense-in-depth (rule 05.2): the agent pod is not authoritative
  -- on upstream credentials. Strip every known client-supplied auth
  -- header so the BSP attached to the AIServiceBackend is the SOLE
  -- source of upstream credentials. Covers the OpenAI-compat Bearer
  -- vs x-api-key collision and any future header-based auth scheme.
  -- Lua header writes propagate to extProc and the BSP injection
  -- point (only body writes don't — see envoyproxy/envoy#14627).
  req:headers():remove("authorization")
  req:headers():remove("x-api-key")
  req:headers():remove("anthropic-api-key")
end
